description: This file defines an interface for CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery) defense strategies within the Apache OFBiz framework, including methods for token generation, validation, modification, and handling invalid tokens.

classes.name: ICsrfDefenseStrategy
classes.description: An interface outlining the methods for CSRF defense strategies, such as token generation, validation, and management.

methods.name: maxSubFolderInRequestUrlForTokenMapLookup
methods.description: Determines the maximum allowed subfolder depth in request URLs for CSRF token map lookup.

methods.name: modifySecurityCsrfToken
methods.description: Allows overriding the CSRF token value in the request map.

methods.name: keepTokenAfterUse
methods.description: Indicates whether the CSRF token should be reused after being consumed.

methods.name: invalidTokenResponse
methods.description: Handles the response when an invalid CSRF token is detected, potentially throwing an exception.
